title: Thick Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
summary: A thick, creamy breakfast smoothie of frozen banana, peanut butter, milk and yoghurt, with a pinch of salt to bring out the nutty flavour.

ingredients.item: ripe bananas, sliced and frozen (about 240 g peeled)
fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: only if the bananas are not frozen

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Slice the peeled bananas, spread them on a plate and freeze for at least 2 hours, or overnight in a bag. Frozen banana makes the smoothie thick and cold without watering it down.

steps.title: Load
steps.text: Pour the milk and yoghurt into the blender first so the blades turn freely, then add the peanut butter, salt and frozen banana.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Pulse a few times to break up the banana, then blend on high for about a minute, scraping down once, until completely smooth.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: If it is too thick to pour, blend in a splash more milk. If your bananas were not frozen, blend in the ice now. Pour into glasses and serve.

tips: The riper the banana, the sweeter the smoothie, so no added sugar is needed.
Freeze ripe bananas in slices so they are always ready.
Swap the yoghurt for more milk for a thinner drink.
storage: Best drunk straight away; it separates as it stands. Shake or re-blend briefly if needed. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
